definitions.explanation: The area in an airport or station where arriving passengers exit to meet people waiting for them. The opposite of the departure gate.

examples.japanese: {到着口|とうちゃくぐち}で{待|ま}っている。
examples.english: I'm waiting at the arrivals gate.

examples.japanese: {到着口|とうちゃくぐち}は1{階|かい}にあります。
examples.english: The arrivals exit is on the first floor.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}を{迎|むか}えに{空港|くうこう}の{到着口|とうちゃくぐち}まで{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the airport arrivals gate to pick up my friend.

notes:
Compound of {到着|とうちゃく} (arrival) and {口|ぐち} (gate/exit/mouth). A practical travel vocabulary word seen on signs in airports and train stations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {到着口|とうちゃくぐち}で{待|ま}つ: to wait at the arrivals gate
- {到着口|とうちゃくぐち}に{迎|むか}えに{行|い}く: to go to the arrivals gate to meet someone
- {国際線|こくさいせん}{到着口|とうちゃくぐち}: international arrivals gate
- {国内線|こくないせん}{到着口|とうちゃくぐち}: domestic arrivals gate

RELATED WORDS:
- {出発口|しゅっぱつぐち}: departure gate — the opposite
- {到着|とうちゃく}: arrival
- {到着|とうちゃく}ロビー: arrivals lobby
- {搭乗口|とうじょうぐち}: boarding gate — where passengers board the plane

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {改札口|かいさつぐち}: ticket gate — at train stations
- {出口|でぐち}: exit — general term for any exit
- {入口|いりぐち}: entrance — general term for any entrance
